240-3480-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-3480-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4885-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2146-3532-5078-5957.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2349-2724-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Mistmeadow Witch. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4063-5220-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2097-3809-4222-4917.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
2097-3809-4222-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
2097-3809-4222-4917.notes: Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.

413-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
413-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2457-3000-4289-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

628-2438-7187.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

5170-5686-6132-6794.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness

3573-5090-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
3573-5090-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Singing Bell Strike attached using Tolarian Academy's ability by tapping it, adding at least seven {U}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

3609-3918--127.easyPrerequisites: Other creatures you control have total power 3 or greater.
3609-3918--127.description:
Activate Trazyn using a Spacecraft's station ability by tapping a creature you control, putting a number of charge counters on Trazyn equal to the creature's power.
If necessary, repeat step 1 until Trazyn has three or more charge counters on it.
Activate Trazyn using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1350-2034-2793-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

589-4017-5796.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-4017-5796.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
589-4017-5796.description:
Gain life.
Fathom Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1778-2757-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest.
215-1778-2757-5705.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Memnite, untapping the Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the Forest.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If desired, once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite {C}, and then you may forego tapping or sacrificing them on future iterations to get infinite creature tokens.

2034-2366-2692-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

962-2713-4449-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
962-2713-4449-4613.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash using Hateflayer's ability by paying {R} and untapping it, causing Yurlok of Scorch Thrash to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch // Temple of Cyclical Time

2292-5550-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2292-5550-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 4.

1636-2857-4890.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2857-4890.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying {2}{U}{R}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Dack's Duplicate.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Dack's Duplicate to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-1926-3983.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Insect" chosen with Species Specialist.
1339-1926-3983.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Species Specialist triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

722-3153-3734.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2232-3426-4050.description:
Cast Deranged Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Deranged Hermit trigger, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
When the Squirrels enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers four times.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Deranged Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining triggers, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Squirrels, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Squirrels, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1742-2314-4052.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
"Drake" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
1742-2314-4052.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Drake Haven triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Drake creature token.
When the Drake enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3129-4659-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
3129-4659-5320.description:
Use Krark-Clan Ironworks to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
3129-4659-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Krark-Clan Ironworks, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

3510-3875-4694-4875.notablePrerequisites:
"Saproling" chosen with Conspiracy.
You have a land card in hand, and are able to play a land this turn.
3510-3875-4694-4875.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Provisioner, creating a Food or a Treasure token.
The Food or Treasure token enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling artifact creature that is also a Forest land due to March of the Machines, Life and Limb, and Conspiracy.
Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Food or a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.

803-1224-2452.description:
Cast Psychic Pickpocket by paying {0}.
Psychic Pickpocket enters the battlefield, causing itself to connive and return itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2011-4076-4772.easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
2011-4076-4772.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

165-1283-2440.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Spirits.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1283-2440.description:
Activate Daxos by paying {3}, creating a Spirit enchantment creature token with power and toughness equal to the number of experience counters you have.
The Spirit entering the battlefield  triggers Mana Echoes, adding at least {3}.
Repeat.
